entities.name: Riza
entities.description: An Abzan patrol captain who leads fifty soldiers along the Salt Road and chooses to make a stand at an oasis against a Mardu horde.

entities.name: Mardu hordechief
entities.description: The unnamed leader of a Mardu horde who maintains his authority by never showing doubt and who orders an attack on the Abzan patrol.

entities.name: Ogan Shieldmender
entities.description: Riza's krumar chief of scales, ordered to form a shield wall at the canyon mouth.

entities.name: Backstabber
entities.description: A Mardu warrior who counts the horde's stolen supplies.

entities.name: Nightrider
entities.description: The hordechief's advisor, with whom he discusses the horde's next target.

entities.name: Mardu quartermaster
entities.description: A Mardu advisor who questions the order to attack and is punished by the hordechief by losing a fingertip.

entities.name: Abzan patrol
entities.description: A fifty-strong Abzan patrol that polices the Salt Road and protects shepherds.

entities.name: Mardu horde
entities.description: A Mardu warband of orcs, humans, goblins and horses that raids shepherd camps and pursues the Abzan patrol.

entities.name: Salt Road
entities.description: A road on the Tarkir steppes that the Abzan patrol polices.

entities.name: Canyon Falls
entities.description: An oasis in a canyon with a spring and palms where the Abzan patrol sets its defense.

entities.name: Golem Rock
entities.description: A landmark on the steppes near which smoke is first seen.

entities.name: Sandsteppe Gateway
entities.description: An Abzan area fed by the shepherds that Riza fears will be left unprotected.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: The warring plane where the Abzan and Mardu clans clash.

events.summary: Riza and his Abzan patrol of fifty march along the Salt Road, and Riza notes the smoke on the horizon is not a Mardu camp.
events.quote: But that is no Mardu encampment.

events.summary: The patrol finds a shepherds' summer camp destroyed, with every villager killed, and Riza orders the dead buried, fearing the horde of at least one hundred that did it.
events.quote: The small village lay in utter desolation. No survivors were left.

events.summary: The Mardu hordechief feasts on the loot and has his advisors plan the next raid while privately hiding his own self-doubt.
events.quote: The shepherds will be moving their flocks north to the villages for winter.

events.summary: A goblin spy tells the hordechief that an Abzan patrol half their size is tailing them and has seen the shepherd camp.
events.quote: An Abzan patrol is tailing us, only half a day's ride to the south.

events.summary: Riza decides against direct confrontation and orders the patrol to fall back to the Canyon Falls oasis to await a larger Salt Road patrol.
events.quote: We will fall back to the oasis at Canyon Falls and await the larger Salt Road patrol.

events.summary: The hordechief orders an immediate attack on the Abzan patrol and cuts off the tip of the quartermaster's finger when she questions him.
events.quote: who quickly snatched it, drew his knife, and sliced the tip off the pinky finger before she could react.

events.summary: The Mardu horde rides through the night; the Abzan spy buzzard reports it is turning to engage and will arrive before noon.
events.quote: The horde has turned south to engage us,

events.summary: Riza settles on retreating to the oasis canyon to nullify the Mardu cavalry advantage, ordering double time.
events.quote: Let's give ourselves the best odds.

events.summary: The hordechief hides his doubts about the gamble, believing he cannot show weakness if he wants to remain hordechief.
events.quote: To change course would be a sign of uncertainty.

events.summary: At the oasis, Riza orders a shield wall, hidden archers, and an ambush, and rallies his soldiers.
events.quote: Hide our archers among the boulders along the west rim of the canyon to keep the horde away from that side.

events.summary: The Mardu horde nears the oasis; the Abzan form a shield wall and endure a barrage of arrows.
events.quote: The air hummed with the flight of arrows.

events.summary: The Mardu horde splits in two to attack both ends of the canyon, and the hordechief glimpses an Abzan siege elephant tower.
events.quote: He rose in his saddle just in time to see the tower of the Abzan siege elephant poking through the haze in the distance…

relations.quote: We are outnumbered two to one," Riza, the patrol captain, said to his top lieutenants

relations.note: Riza serves in the Abzan military.
relations.quote: together we will make a defense worthy of our Abzan heritage.

relations.note: He rules the horde through unwavering certainty.
relations.quote: Their survival depends on my unwavering certainty.

relations.note: Riza's krumar chief of scales follows his orders.
relations.quote: Ogan Shieldmender, join us," Riza said to his Mardu krumar chief of scales

relations.note: The horde hunts the patrol after its raid.
relations.quote: The foolish Abzan have sent a patrol after us that is half our strength.

relations.note: He counts supplies on the hordechief's order.
relations.quote: Backstabber, take stock of our new supplies and figure how long before we must loot again.
He motioned his advisor to come closer.
